en-US.home_logline: Build your deck of creatures to battle against others. Plenty of different strategies and ways to win. The board is your Arena!
en-US.home_about_text: Sunborne is a non-profit game of cards and strategy developed natively for web browsers, with zero downloads or dependencies. All you have to do is create your profile and start exploring the game.
home_features_section: Here you will summon minions and order them to fight for you
Build your collection by wins, challenges and milestones
Play in different modes, each with its unique identity
